title: Carlet's Kasami cyclic-additive conjecture
summary: A Lean formalization of the Kasami cyclic-additive conjecture introduced by Claude Carlet. For the derivative image of the Kasami monomial x^(4^k-2^k+1) with gcd(k,n)=1, over a finite field of characteristic two with 2^n elements, the formalized result gives the exact three-variable coefficient count 2^(2n-3) for every pair of distinct nonzero coefficients.

review.reason: Lean formalization of a coefficient count for Kasami monomial derivatives over finite fields.
